questionText: In Business Unit #11, Partner A is entitled to a commission of 10% on net profits after charging such commission. The net profit of the firm before charging any commission is Rs. 330,000. Compute the amount of commission payable to partner A.

topic: Revaluation and Reserves: Investment Fluctuation Reserve
questionText: Balance Sheet of partners A and B (Set #6) shows Investments (at cost) Rs. 125,000 and Investment Fluctuation Reserve of Rs. 80,000. On admission of C, market value of investments is Rs. 85,000. How will the reserve be treated?

options.text: Entire Rs. 80,000 transferred to Revaluation Account credit
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Entire Rs. 80,000 transferred to Revaluation Account credit'.

options.text: Rs. 40,000 used to write down Investment; remaining Rs. 40,000 credited to old partners in old ratio
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Conforms to standard NCERT Accountancy principles and accounting standards.

options.text: Loss of Rs. 40,000 debited to Revaluation Account without using IFR
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Loss of Rs. 40,000 debited to Revaluation Account without using IFR'.

options.text: No entry is passed until the investments are sold
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'No entry is passed until the investments are sold'.

detailedSolution:
1. Fall in market value of investments = Rs. 40,000.
2. The Investment Fluctuation Reserve of Rs. 80,000 is first utilized to absorb this fall of Rs. 40,000.
3. The surplus balance of Rs. 40,000 is distributed among old partners A and B in their old ratio (3:2).
Hence, Option B is correct.

options.text: Full Rs. 84,000 distributed to old partners ignoring the claim
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Full Rs. 84,000 distributed to old partners ignoring the claim'.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses concept details with distractor 'Debited to Revaluation Account as a loss'.
